claim: On October 19, 1939, President Roosevelt wrote to Albert Einstein that he had convened a Board to thoroughly investigate the possibilities of his suggestion regarding the element of uranium.

evidence.quote: I found this data of such import that I have convened a Board consisting of the head of the Bureau of Standards and a chosen representative of the Army and Navy to thoroughly investigate the possibilities of your suggestion regarding the element of uranium.
evidence.locator: psfa0064.pdf, page 9 (letter dated October 19, 1939); read from the page image, OCR is poor
